 Dated this the 27th day of February, 2025  ORDER A.Muhamed Mustaque, J.
We received the statement filed by the 79 th and 80th respondents.

As seen from their statement,
Ext.P34 report is not a fabricated one.
It is stated that it is only a privileged communication between the Panchayath and the standing counsel.

2. We are not looking into Ext.P34 now for the simple reason that the larger issue now is in the hands of the District Collector, and the District Collector is so far not chosen to file a statement in this matter.
